title: Cosmic Heart Bearer
description: A surreal female figure with flowing cosmic hair stands in a vibrant striped landscape under an aurora-filled night sky. She holds an ornate glowing green heart inside a moss-covered arched lantern in her hands while her other arm reaches upward, releasing small green fish into the starry heavens.
